workflow: An object-initialization interface accepts malformed field metadata containing a non-text value.
Initialization passes the value to a text-specific length or formatting operation without validating its representation.
The operation interprets the non-text object using text-object layout and reads beyond the object's valid storage.
The out-of-bounds access triggers a global buffer overflow and process termination instead of a recoverable validation error.
summary: Malformed metadata type confusion causes out-of-bounds text access
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as heterogeneous record misinterpretation: an object of the wrong representation is accepted where a specific record type is expected, its layout is interpreted incorrectly, and an out-of-bounds access results.
